name: Ask Captain Lawgof about the damaged stockade

evidence.note: Captain Lawgof supplies replacement railing pieces.

name: Take the hammer from the building east of Lawgof

evidence.note: Take the available hammer if needed and return to Lawgof’s waypoint.

name: Inspect and repair the stockade railings

evidence.note: Inspect the six railing positions. Repair the damaged sections with the supplied pieces, then report to Lawgof.

planned_outcome.success_condition: All damaged railing sections are repaired and Lawgof acknowledges the work.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Check the six railing tiles and get replacement pieces from Lawgof if needed.

name: Climb the watchtower and collect the dwarf’s remains

evidence.note: Climb the two ladders and recover the remains. Descend to the surface.

name: Give Lawgof the remains

evidence.note: Lawgof explains that his son Lollk may be in the goblin cave.

name: Search the goblin cave crates for Lollk

evidence.note: Enter the cave and search the northwestern crates. Return to the surface once Lollk escapes.

name: Report the rescue and repair Lawgof’s multicannon

evidence.note: Get the toolkit, match each tool to the broken cannon component and ask Lawgof what to do next.

name: Get the ammo mould and notes from Nulodion

evidence.note: Nulodion gives the mould and instructions to take back to Lawgof.

name: Give Nulodion’s instructions to Captain Lawgof

evidence.note: Award 750 Crafting XP and one quest point. The player keeps the ammo mould.

name: Buy beer, a saw and a hammer

evidence.note: Budget 500 GP for the beer and reusable tools.

name: Ask Effigy about the tower

evidence.note: Effigy sends the player to Bonafido. The helper lists level 10 Construction.

name: Ask Bonafido why work has stopped

evidence.note: Bonafido asks the player to dress as a builder.

name: Get the four pieces of the builder outfit

evidence.note: Answer Black-eye’s questions for the hat, speak to and pickpocket No Fingers for the boots, give The Guns a beer for the shirt, and search the southern bushes for trousers.

name: Pass Bonafido’s questions and enter the tower

evidence.note: Wear all four pieces and answer the builder questions before entering.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Bonafido accepts the outfit and the answers, and the tower opens.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Equip all four pieces and repeat the dialogue.

name: Build and calibrate the pressure machine

evidence.note: Collect three sheets, four balls and four valve wheels from the crates, build the machine on the first floor and calibrate it.

name: Build and connect the pipe machine

evidence.note: Get four pipes, five rings and six rivets, build the machine on the second floor and arrange the pipe puzzle.

name: Build and assemble the cage

evidence.note: Collect five bars and four binding fluids, then assemble the cage upstairs.

name: Report the repairs and confront the alchemists

evidence.note: Report the machines to Effigy, follow the alchemists upstairs, and talk to the homunculus through the sequence.

name: Find the homunculus in the basement

evidence.note: Use the trapdoor after the alchemists leave.

name: Speak to the homunculus to finish the quest

evidence.note: Award 1,000 Construction XP and 500 each in Crafting and Thieving.

name: Buy three planks, a bronze bar and molten glass

evidence.note: Budget 430 GP for the professor’s materials.

name: Ask the Observatory professor what needs repairing

evidence.note: The professor asks for planks, a bronze bar and molten glass.

name: Give the professor the repair materials

evidence.note: Hand over three planks, a bronze bar and the glass. The route reserves the glass for lens making when the professor returns it.

name: Search the dungeon and recover the lens mould

evidence.note: Find the kitchen key in the marked chests. Trap or defeat the goblin guard, take the mould from the stove and exit the dungeon.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Recover the mould and return to the dungeon entrance.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Check the eligible chests and use the safe guard-trapping path if avoiding combat.

name: Show the mould and make the replacement lens

evidence.note: Speak to the professor for the glass, form the lens and keep it ready for installation.

name: Give the finished lens to the professor

evidence.note: Hand over the replacement lens. The professor goes to the observatory.

name: Walk through the dungeon to the telescope

evidence.note: Follow the dungeon path to the observatory staircase, then go up to the telescope.

name: Use the telescope and tell the professor which constellation appeared

evidence.note: View the constellation, wait for the cutscene and choose the correct name. Award the guaranteed 2,250 Crafting XP.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Identify the constellation shown by the telescope.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Review the observation and select the matching constellation.

name: Buy the Dig Site exam and excavation supplies

evidence.note: Budget 800 GP for the tea, vial, cut opal, charcoal, two ropes and pestle and mortar.

name: Ask the Examiner about Earth Sciences

evidence.note: The Examiner gives a letter for Curator Haig Halen.

name: Have Curator Haig Halen sign the letter

evidence.note: Get the recommendation stamped at the Varrock Museum.

name: Return the sealed letter to the Examiner

evidence.note: Register for the exams. Ask the students about topics you have not yet studied.

name: Find the teddy in the bushes

evidence.note: Walk to the bushes north of the Exam Centre, find the teddy and return to the waypoint.

name: Give the guide tea and pan for the special cup

evidence.note: Take a tray and give the guide a cup of tea. Pan and inspect the tray until the special cup is found.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Recover the special cup from the panning tray.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Repeat panning and check the tray again.

name: Obtain the specimen brush and animal skull from the workmen

evidence.note: Pickpocket workmen until both items are obtained.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Obtain the brush and animal skull.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Repeat the pickpockets, healing if necessary.

name: Return the students’ belongings and learn the first exam topics

evidence.note: Return the teddy, cup and skull to the corresponding students and speak to each again for their answers.

name: Pass the level-one Earth Sciences exam

evidence.note: Use the answers learned from the three students and receive the first certificate and the trowel.

name: Ask the students about level-two Earth Sciences

evidence.note: Speak to all three students for the second exam topics.

name: Pass the level-two Earth Sciences exam

evidence.note: Use the students’ answers and receive the second certificate.

name: Give the student an opal and learn the level-three topics

evidence.note: Give the cut opal to the northwestern student and speak to all three about the final exam.

name: Pass the level-three exam and collect a specimen jar

evidence.note: Get the third certificate and take a jar from the cupboard in the western room.

name: Excavate the ancient talisman

evidence.note: Use the trowel on the level-three soil while carrying the brush and jar.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Find the ancient talisman in the level-three soil.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Continue digging until the talisman is recovered.

name: Show the talisman to the archaeological expert

evidence.note: The expert gives a letter authorizing use of the shafts.

name: Show the invitation, enter the west shaft and inspect the blockage

evidence.note: Show a workman the invitation, attach one rope, descend, take an arcenia root, inspect the obstruction and climb back out.

name: Attach a second rope and speak to Doug Deeping

evidence.note: Descend the northeastern shaft. Doug gives a key to the chest in the supply tent.

name: Retrieve the two unidentified quest reagents

evidence.note: Use Doug’s key on the tent chest, and use the trowel and empty vial at the nearby barrel. Keep the quest items for the expert.

name: Identify the reagents with the expert and prepare the quest compound

evidence.note: Use the unidentified items on the expert. Use the game’s mixing steps with the ground charcoal and the root.

name: Clear the west shaft obstruction and recover the stone tablet

evidence.note: Descend the west shaft, apply the quest compound to the obstruction and use the tinderbox. Move clear of the game effect, collect the tablet and climb out.

name: Give the stone tablet to the archaeological expert

evidence.note: Award Mining and Herblore XP, two gold bars and two quest points. This completion flag can satisfy Bone Voyage’s Dig Site gate.

name: Ask Captain Tock about his crew’s curse

evidence.note: Captain Tock directs the player to the departure west of Rimmington.

name: Meet Captain Tock and sail to Corsair Cove

evidence.note: Take Tock’s ship to the Cove.

name: Speak to Ithoi in his hut

evidence.note: Ithoi gives his account of the crew’s illness.

name: Hear the crew’s accounts

evidence.note: Speak to Arsen, Colin and Gnocci in their huts.

name: Collect the spade from the sand

evidence.note: Take the spade south of the crew huts and return.

name: Collect the tinderbox near Gnocci

evidence.note: Collect the tinderbox in Gnocci’s hut and return.

name: Tell Captain Tock about the crew’s stories

evidence.note: Board the ship and ask Tock for the artefact.

name: Return the ogre artefact to Chief Tess

evidence.note: Enter the cave, return the artefact to Tess and climb out.

name: Dig next to the tree to investigate the doll

evidence.note: Dig at the marked tile and check what was buried.

name: Look through Ithoi’s telescope

evidence.note: Check what the telescope shows.

name: Return to Gnocci, Arsen and Colin with the findings

evidence.note: Resolve the three accounts using what the player found.

name: Tell Captain Tock the stories were explained

evidence.note: Tock asks the player to check the food.

name: Ask Gnocci and Arsen about the food

evidence.note: Ask about the source of the crew’s food.

name: Speak to Ithoi and light the driftwood beneath his hut

evidence.note: Speak to Ithoi, go down the ramp, use the tinderbox on the driftwood and watch the cutscene.

name: Tell Captain Tock what happened beneath the hut

evidence.note: Tock asks the player to confront Ithoi.

name: Defeat Ithoi in his hut

evidence.note: Defeat Ithoi the Navigator, who uses Magic.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Defeat Ithoi and survive the fight.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Return with a suitable combat setup and food.

name: Report Ithoi’s defeat to Captain Tock

evidence.note: Build 242 awards 1,200 Firemaking XP and two quest points, and opens the bank and ferry.

name: Help Femi carry sacks through the Stronghold gate

evidence.note: Help with the sacks before Glough sets the guard to earn a favor for the return trip.

name: Ask King Narnode what is happening to the Grand Tree

evidence.note: Speak to King Narnode through the opening sequence. He supplies the translation book and bark sample.

name: Show Hazelmere the bark and translate his message

evidence.note: Climb the ladder, show him the bark and use the translation book for the message.

name: Tell King Narnode what Hazelmere discovered

evidence.note: Tell the king about the Daconia stone. He directs the player to Glough.

name: Ask Glough about Hazelmere’s message

evidence.note: Climb to Glough’s house and question him.

name: Report back to the king and speak to Charlie

evidence.note: Report to the king and climb to Charlie’s cell. Charlie directs the player to Glough’s journal.

name: Search Glough’s cupboard and get taken to the cell

evidence.note: Find Glough’s journal, confront him and let the arrest sequence play out.

name: Speak to Charlie and Narnode and escape to Karamja

evidence.note: Get the Shipyard password from Charlie and take the quest-only glider with Errdo. Walk from the landing to the gate.

name: Give the Shipyard password and find the foreman

evidence.note: Give Glough’s password at the gate and walk to the foreman’s dock.

name: Answer the foreman’s questions and get the lumber order

evidence.note: Answer the questions about Glough in the foreman’s office, then leave the Shipyard.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The foreman accepts the answers and gives the lumber order.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Use Charlie’s information and retry the foreman dialogue.

name: Ask Femi to return the favor

evidence.note: Femi helps the player return through the gate for free after receiving help with her sacks.

name: Pay Femi for help entering the Stronghold

evidence.note: This route uses the 1,000 GP gate payment when Femi has no earlier favor to repay.

name: Return to King Narnode with the lumber order

evidence.note: Return by the Stronghold spirit tree or with Femi’s help. Give the king the lumber order.

name: Talk to Anita and receive Glough’s key

evidence.note: Climb to Anita’s room and speak to her about Glough.

name: Use Anita’s key and recover the invasion plans

evidence.note: Unlock Glough’s chest and take the plans.

name: Give the invasion plans to King Narnode

evidence.note: Narnode gives four twigs for the watchtower puzzle.

name: Climb the watchtower, arrange the twigs and descend

evidence.note: Climb the tree at Glough’s house, arrange T, U, Z and O, and descend the trapdoor into the demon sequence.

name: Defeat the Black Demon under the Grand Tree

evidence.note: Defeat the level 172 quest demon. Use suitable combat gear and supplies. A ranged or Magic safe spot is possible.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Defeat the demon and reach King Narnode in the cave.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Use the safe spot with suitable ammunition or runes, and return with enough supplies.

name: Ask Narnode about the roots and find the Daconia stone

evidence.note: Speak to Narnode, then search the cave roots for the stone.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Recover the Daconia stone from the roots.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Check the remaining roots before returning to Narnode.

name: Give King Narnode the Daconia stone

evidence.note: Award the fixed XP and unlock gliders and the Stronghold spirit tree departure.

name: Ask Arthur, Gawain and Lancelot about Merlin

evidence.note: Learn who trapped Merlin and how to reach the keep.

name: Ride Arhein’s crate to Keep Le Faye

evidence.note: Arrange shipment passage and hide in the crate, then climb to Mordred.

name: Defeat Sir Mordred and speak to Morgan

evidence.note: Force Morgan to intervene and finish her dialogue.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Morgan explains how to release Merlin.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Bring effective gear and food, and repeat the fight if the conversation was interrupted.

name: Collect wax from a Catherby beehive

evidence.note: Collect repellent from Catherby before using a hive.

name: Trade the wax for a black candle

evidence.note: Speak to the Candle Maker twice to obtain the candle.

name: Collect bat bones near Keep Le Faye

evidence.note: Defeat a giant bat and pick up its bones.

name: Ask the Lady of the Lake for Excalibur

evidence.note: The Lady sends the player to Port Sarim for a trial.

name: Give the beggar bread and receive Excalibur

evidence.note: Try the shop door, give the beggar the loaf and receive Excalibur during the encounter.

name: Read the altar inscription in Varrock

evidence.note: Learn the words needed for the Camelot ritual.

name: Perform the ritual at the Camelot star

evidence.note: Light the candle, drop the bones on the star and use the altar’s words.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The spirit agrees to release Merlin.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Obtain a fresh candle if the incorrect words were used.

name: Use Excalibur on Merlin’s crystal

evidence.note: Use the sword from inventory on the crystal. The item interaction does not require wielding the sword.

name: Report Merlin’s release to King Arthur

evidence.note: Excalibur is obtained during the trial. Arthur awards the quest points and the Quest Month Firemaking reward.

name: Accept Arthur’s quest and consult Merlin

evidence.note: Begin with King Arthur and speak to Merlin upstairs.

name: Speak to the High Priest and the Crone

evidence.note: Finish the church conversations on Entrana to learn about the Fisher Realm.

name: Receive the holy table napkin from Galahad

evidence.note: Ask Galahad for an item from the Fisher Realm.

name: Pick up two magic whistles at Draynor Manor

evidence.note: Carry the napkin upstairs to reveal the two whistles.

name: Blow a whistle under the Brimhaven watchtower

evidence.note: Enter the first version of the Fisher Realm carrying Excalibur.

name: Defeat the Black Knight Titan with an Excalibur finishing blow

evidence.note: Wield Excalibur for the finishing blow. Speak to the fisherman across the bridge before leaving the first realm.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The Titan is defeated with Excalibur and the fisherman explains the bell.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Bring effective gear and food, save Excalibur for the final blow, and finish the fisherman’s dialogue.

name: Ring the bell and meet the Fisher King

evidence.note: Pick up the bell outside the wall, ring it there, climb the stairs and finish the Fisher King’s dialogue.

name: Report to Arthur and receive the magic gold feather

evidence.note: Arthur gives a feather to help locate Percival.

name: Free Percival and give him a magic whistle

evidence.note: Open the sacks and give Percival one of the two whistles.

name: Blow the remaining whistle under the watchtower

evidence.note: Return to the restored realm and approach the castle.

name: Collect the grail upstairs in the restored castle

evidence.note: Enter the castle and take the grail on the upper floor.

name: Deliver the grail to King Arthur

evidence.note: Hand over the grail to Arthur.
